proof_body:
by
  intro p q s t r _ hirr h
  by_cases hqt : q = t
  · subst hqt
    have hps : (p : ℝ) = (s : ℝ) := by linarith
    exact ⟨by exact_mod_cast hps, rfl⟩
  · exfalso
    apply hirr
    have hne : (q : ℝ) - (t : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      exact sub_ne_zero.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hqt)
    refine ⟨(s - p) / (q - t), ?_⟩
    push_cast
    rw [div_eq_iff hne]
    linear_combination -h
target_source: ∀ (p q s t : ℚ) (r : ℝ), 0 ≤ r → Irrational (Real.sqrt r) → (p : ℝ) + (q : ℝ) * Real.sqrt r = (s : ℝ) + (t : ℝ) * Real.sqrt r → p = s ∧ q = t
